name: Twin Anemia-Polycythemia Sequence

prevalence.estimate: 1 in 5,000 to 1 in 10,000 monochorionic twin pregnancies

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Prenatal Doppler Ultrasound Diagnostic Criteria for TAPS

criteria.description: Middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA-PSV) >1.5 multiples of the median (MoM) in the donor twin indicating anemia
MCA-PSV <1.0 MoM in the recipient twin indicating polycythemia
Postnatal intertwin hemoglobin difference >8 g/dL confirming diagnosis
Absence of classical twin-twin transfusion syndrome features such as discordant amniotic fluid volumes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of discordant MCA-PSV values consistent with anemia and polycythemia in respective twins, confirmed by postnatal hemoglobin difference >8 g/dL
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily prenatal via Doppler ultrasound; postnatal confirmation is essential.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Discordant fetal middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocities
searchTerms: unequal blood flow in fetal brain artery

common.notes: Leads to pallor and hydrops fetalis if severe
searchTerms: low fetal blood count in donor twin
donor twin with low red cells
high fetal red blood cells in recipient twin

common.notes: Less pronounced than in twin-twin transfusion syndrome

occasional.notes: Due to ischemic injury or hyperviscosity
searchTerms: brain or nerve problems after birth

occasional.notes: Less severe than in twin-twin transfusion syndrome

rare.symptomName: Intrauterine fetal demise of one twin
searchTerms: death of one twin before birth
loss of one fetus in womb

rare.symptomName: Placental vascular anastomoses visible on imaging

searchTerms: blood clots after birth in recipient twin

laboratory: Elevated reticulocyte count in donor twin
imaging: Doppler ultrasound showing discordant MCA-PSV values
Absence of amniotic fluid discordance typical of twin-twin transfusion syndrome
Placental vascular anastomoses on postnatal examination
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; condition related to placental vascular anatomy
other: Histopathological evidence of small arterio-venous anastomoses in placenta

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of significant amniotic fluid discordance (polyhydramnios-oligohydramnios sequence)
Bidirectional blood flow through large placental vascular anastomoses
Bilateral fetal anemia without polycythemia in co-twin

redFlags: Severe fetal anemia leading to hydrops fetalis
Neurological impairment or fetal demise if untreated
references: Slaghekke F, et al. Twin anemia-polycythemia sequence: diagnosis, classification, and management. Am J Obstet Gynecol. 2010.
Robyr R, et al. Twin anemia-polycythemia sequence: a review. Prenat Diagn. 2017.
